name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: Accessible one-time password component with copy paste functionality.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether to auto-focus the first input.

props.name: autoSubmit
props.description: Whether to auto-submit the owning form when all inputs are filled.

props.name: blurOnComplete
props.description: Whether to blur the input when the value is complete

props.name: count
props.description:
The number of inputs to render to improve SSR aria attributes.
This will be required in next major version.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the the pin input when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the pin input.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the inputs are disabled

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input element.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the pin input. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the pin input is in the invalid state

props.name: mask
props.description: If `true`, the input's value will be masked just like `type=password`

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input element. Useful for form submission.

props.name: otp
props.description:
If `true`, the pin input component signals to its fields that they should
use `autocomplete="one-time-code"`.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The regular expression that the user-entered input value is checked against.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The placeholder text for the input

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the pin input is in the valid state

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the pin input is required

props.name: sanitizeValue
props.description:
Function to sanitize pasted values before validation.
Useful for stripping dashes, spaces, or other formatting.

props.name: selectOnFocus
props.description: Whether to select input value when input is focused

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: type
props.description: The type of value the pin-input should allow

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the the pin input.

events.name: onValueComplete
events.description: Function called when all inputs have valid values

events.name: onValueInvalid
events.description: Function called when an invalid value is entered

keyboard.description: Types into the focused slot and advances to the next one (character set constrained by `pattern` or `type`).
Clears the focused slot and moves focus to the previous slot.
Moves focus to the adjacent slot.
Pastes and distributes a full code across the slots, validated against `pattern`/`type`.

accessibilityNotes: Each slot renders as a real `<input>` with `aria-label` identifying its position ("digit N of M"), `aria-invalid` when the `invalid` prop is set, and `data-complete`/`data-disabled` state attributes shared with the root for styling hooks.

Only one slot is ever tabbable at a time — the machine keeps `tabindex=0` on the next empty slot (or the last filled one when complete) and `tabindex=-1` on the rest, so Tab moves straight from the input into and back out of the whole group instead of stopping at every slot.

A visually-hidden native `<input>` mirrors the joined value for native form participation (`name`, `required`, `form` all pass through to it), so the component works inside a plain HTML form submit without extra wiring.
Pasting a full code is supported and validated against `pattern`/`type` before it's accepted; an invalid paste is rejected rather than partially applied.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Set `length` to the number of slots the code should have.

examples.title: Pattern
examples.description: Constrain accepted characters with `pattern`, a regular-expression source string. Upstream imports the `REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS`/`REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS_AND_CHARS` constants from the `input-otp` package; this port inlines the equivalent regex source directly since that package isn't a dependency here.

examples.title: Grouped
examples.description: Set `groupSize` to insert a separator between fixed-size groups of slots.

examples.title: Masked
examples.description: Pass `mask` to render entered characters as dots, like a password field.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled input is skipped by the tab order and ignores pointer input.

examples.title: Invalid
examples.source:
import InputOTP from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-otp/input-otp.marko";

<InputOTP length=6 defaultValue=["0","0","0","0","0","0"] groupSize=2 invalid/>
examples.description: Pass `invalid` to mark every slot's `aria-invalid`/`data-invalid` state. The machine applies this at the root, not per slot — upstream instead sets `aria-invalid` on individual `InputOTPSlot`s, which this single-tag port has no equivalent for.

examples.title: Four Digits
examples.description: A common pattern for PIN codes: set `length=4` with a digits-only `pattern`.

examples.title: Alphanumeric
examples.source:
import InputOTP from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-otp/input-otp.marko";

<InputOTP length=6 groupSize=3 pattern="^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$"/>
examples.description: Use a `pattern` that accepts both letters and numbers.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import InputOTP from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/input-otp/input-otp.marko";

Value: ${value.join("")}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, which receives the array of per-slot characters.

examples.title: RTL
examples.description: The machine's own `dir` prop drives right-to-left slot layout and arrow-key navigation directly, with no separate RTL configuration step.

composition: `InputOTP` is a single component, not four. Where upstream composes `InputOTP` / `InputOTPGroup` / `InputOTPSlot` / `InputOTPSeparator`, this port folds all four into one tag backed by a Zag `pin-input` machine: `length` sets the slot count (sugar for the machine's `count` prop) and `groupSize` inserts a separator automatically between fixed-size groups — there is no separate `InputOTPGroup`, `InputOTPSlot`, or `InputOTPSeparator` tag to import or compose by hand.
